logs.description: Stores user interaction events such as viewing products, clicking links, or adding items to cart.

schema.user_id: Integer (Required: ID of the user performing the action)
schema.product_id: Integer (Optional: ID of the product interacted with)
schema.timestamp: Datetime (UTC: Time when the action occurred)

search_history.description: Stores the search queries made by users to improve recommendations and track trends.

schema.user_id: Integer (Required: ID of the searching user)
schema.query: String (Required: The text searched by the user)

chat_messages.description: Stores conversation history between the user and the AI Recommender chatbot.

schema.user_id: Integer (Required: ID of the user in the chat)
schema.role: String (Required: 'user' or 'assistant' based on who sent the message)
schema.timestamp: Datetime (UTC: Time the message was sent)

wishlist.description: Stores products that a user has saved for later (Wishlist/Favorites).

schema.product_id: Integer (Required: ID of the saved product)
schema.added_at: Datetime (UTC: Time when the product was added to wishlist)
